title: Special programs bring secret technology to events without telling Skywatcher, followed by NDAs

tellings.quote: I participated in projects, and special programs brought their own secret developments on our event, not informing us.

plain: Secret government programs brought their own hidden technology to events run by Skywatcher, a startup that tries to call up UFOs, without telling the company, and people were then asked to sign nondisclosure agreements, contracts that bind them to secrecy. James Valor of Skywatcher says this from his own part in those projects at US military events in the 2020s, and if true it would mean some of what the group saw in the sky may have been secret human craft.
